  const seen = new Set<string>()
  return emojis.filter((e) => !seen.has(e.emoji) && seen.add(e.emoji))
}

  const codePoint = e.emoji.codePointAt(0) ?? 0
  return codePoint >= 0x1f1e6 && codePoint <= 0x1f1ff
}
